title: cacalia octantha
intro: Cacalia octantha, commonly known as the Eight-angled Cat's Eye, is a rare species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia octantha are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and immunomodulatory activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential health benefits of this plant.
